name: Character Portrait (bust)
lede: Head-and-shoulders portrait of a single character. The fastest way to put a real face to the PC who has been living in your campaign for the last forty sessions.

included.name: Clean reference handling
included.body: We work from your Hero Forge, sketches, or written brief.

included.name: 4K final delivery
included.body: PNG and JPG at 4K, suitable for print up to 16×16 at 300dpi.

included.name: Transparent background
included.body: Cut-out version included on Standard and Premium.

included.name: 2 revisions baked in
included.body: Two paint-stage rounds plus unlimited sketch tweaks.

faq.q: What's the difference between Basic and Standard?
faq.a: Basic is clean line art with flat color and a simple background. Standard adds full rendering, light and shadow, textured materials, and a suggested setting that fits the character.

faq.q: Can I add a token to this?
faq.a: Yes. The Character + Token bundle adds a matching VTT-ready token for +$25.

faq.q: How many references should I send?
faq.a: 3 to 5 is the sweet spot. A Hero Forge link plus 2 or 3 mood images covers most briefs.

name: Full-body Character Art
lede: Full-figure portrait, head to toe. Painterly rendering, dramatic lighting, the character in their world. The studio's signature offering.

included.name: Sketch stage before paint
included.body: We lock pose and composition with you before any color goes down.

included.name: 4K final delivery
included.body: PNG and JPG, plus a 300dpi print-ready master.

included.name: Transparent background
included.body: Cut-out version on Standard and Premium for VTT use.

included.name: Process updates
included.body: Sketches, color blocks, progress shots every few days.

faq.q: What references work best?
faq.a: A Hero Forge screenshot or rough sketch, plus 2 or 3 mood images for palette and lighting. See our [briefing guide](/blog/how-to-write-commission-brief).

faq.q: How long for the Premium tier?
faq.a: Usually toward the high end of the 7 to 14 day range, plus a day or two for revisions.

faq.q: Do you do non-D&D characters?
faq.a: Yes. Pathfinder, World of Darkness, original settings, homebrew species, sci-fi PCs. Send the brief.

name: Character Reference Sheet
lede: Three to four views of the same character — front, side, three-quarter, plus expressions and detail call-outs. The asset you ship to other artists or use as your own canon reference.

included.name: 3 to 4 angles delivered
included.body: Front, side, three-quarter standard. Add a back view or alt outfit at the top of the range.

included.name: Expression call-outs
included.body: Two to four small head studies showing the character's emotional range.

included.name: Detail break-outs
included.body: Close-ups of gear, magic items, or jewelry, labeled.

faq.q: Why the range in price?
faq.a: $250 is the floor with three views and a single expression. $450 adds extra angles, multiple expressions, and detail breakouts. We quote your specific brief inside that range.

faq.q: Can I commission this for an existing character art piece?
faq.a: Yes. If you commissioned a portrait from us already, the reference sheet can use it as the anchor view and we will build the other angles to match.

name: Character + Token Bundle
lede: Add a circular, VTT-ready token built from the same painting to any character portrait commission. Same palette, same lighting, instant table use.

included.name: Matching style
included.body: Token is built from the same painting, so palette and lighting line up exactly.

included.name: Two export sizes
included.body: 512px and 1024px transparent PNG, ready for Roll20 and Foundry.

included.name: Decorative border
included.body: Painted token frame, simple or themed to match the character.

faq.q: When do I add this?
faq.a: At order time. Tick the bundle box on any character portrait commission.

faq.q: Can I add a token to a portrait I already ordered?
faq.a: Yes, as a follow-up. Use the [convert-to-token](/services/tokens) flow if you have the art already, or order a [single token](/services/tokens) painted from scratch.

name: Party Portrait
lede: Group illustration of an adventuring party, family, or wedding party. Up to 4 figures in one composition at the base tier. Add extras up to 8 figures total.

included.name: Up to 4 figures included
included.body: Add up to 4 more figures at $80 to $120 each, depending on detail level.

included.name: Composition sketch first
included.body: We sketch the group layout before any face is painted, and you approve it.

included.name: Print-ready files
included.body: Delivered at 4K plus a 300dpi master, sized for canvas prints up to 24 inches.

included.name: Surprise-friendly process
included.body: Gift commissions handled discreetly through a co-conspirator at the table.

faq.q: How many figures total?
faq.a: Up to 4 included in the base tier. Up to 8 with extras, at $80 to $120 per additional figure.

faq.q: Can I order this as a surprise gift?
faq.a: Yes. We coordinate references with someone else at the table to keep it secret.

faq.q: Do you do wedding party portraits?
faq.a: Often. Wedding parties as adventurers are one of our most-loved commissions.

name: Matched Party Set
lede: Individual portraits of each party member, painted to a shared style guide. Best for tables that want personal pieces but want them to feel like one campaign.

included.name: Style guide kickoff
included.body: We agree palette, era, and lighting up front, then every portrait holds that line.

included.name: Independent portraits
included.body: Each piece is its own canvas, suited for character sheets, social, and prints.

included.name: Per-piece revisions
included.body: Two revisions on each portrait, not pooled across the set.

faq.q: What's the difference vs. a Party Portrait?
faq.a: Party Portrait is one composition with everyone in it. Matched Set is separate pieces with a shared visual language.

faq.q: Can we add a player mid-set?
faq.a: Yes, at the per-piece rate of your tier. We hold the style guide so the new addition fits.

name: Action / Scene Illustration
lede: Your party in the middle of something. A boss fight, a heist, the council meeting before the war. Story-driven illustration with background, lighting, and momentum.

included.name: Story brief intake
included.body: We sit with the moment first, then sketch toward what it actually is.

included.name: Composition value studies
included.body: Multiple thumbnails before paint, so the storytelling lands.

included.name: Cinematic lighting
included.body: Lighting designed to read the moment, not just illuminate the figures.

faq.q: Why the price range?
faq.a: Scope. $400 is a focused 2 to 3 figure scene with a suggested background. $900 is a cinematic moment with full environmental detail and multiple figures interacting.

faq.q: Can this be a campaign cover?
faq.a: Yes. Talk to us about commercial licensing if it is going to ship publicly. See [/commercial](/commercial).

name: NPC Pack
lede: A bench of supporting characters painted in matching style. The most efficient way to give a published module or homebrew world a face.

included.name: Matching style guarantee
included.body: Every NPC shares the same palette, paper texture, and lighting language.

included.name: Kickoff style call
included.body: Half-hour video call to lock palette, era, and tone before week one.

included.name: VTT tokens bundled
included.body: Each NPC ships with a matching circular token. Normally a +$25 add-on per piece.

included.name: Schedule-friendly delivery
included.body: We commit to a cadence you can plan sessions around, usually 1 to 2 NPCs per week.

faq.q: Can I extend a 5-pack to 10 later?
faq.a: Yes. We hold your style notes for 12 months, and the extra NPCs ship at the same per-piece rate.

faq.q: Do you do published-module casts?
faq.a: Often. Curse of Strahd, Saltmarsh, Storm King's Thunder, Waterdeep, plus homebrew. See our [Strahd pack walkthrough](/blog/strahd-npc-pack-six-weeks).

faq.q: Are tokens really included?
faq.a: Yes. Every NPC in a pack gets a matching token at no extra cost.

name: Monster / Creature Art
lede: Creatures, monsters, and beasts. From a single beholder portrait to a custom homebrew big-bad ready for the table.

included.name: Original or canon
included.body: Painting D&D monsters, Pathfinder beasts, your homebrew abomination, all fair game.

included.name: Token cut included
included.body: Circular VTT token from the same art, at no extra cost on this product.

included.name: Scale callout option
included.body: If you want a human silhouette in-frame for scale, we will include one.

faq.q: Why the price range?
faq.a: $90 is a single-monster bust with a simple background. $250 is a full creature with environmental detail, scale reference, and multiple poses if needed.

faq.q: Can I commission a copyrighted monster?
faq.a: For personal table use, yes (fan art). For commercial use, we would need the rights holder's permission. See [terms](/terms).

name: Item / Artifact Illustrations
lede: Magic items, artifacts, weapons, jewelry, scrolls. Single illustration or 6-piece bundles for an entire loot table.

included.name: Single or bundle
included.body: $30 for one item, $150 for six. The bundle is the better deal once you cross three items.

included.name: Transparent background
included.body: Drop into handouts, loot cards, character sheets.

included.name: Detail callouts (bundle)
included.body: On 6-packs, we will lay them out on a single sheet if you want a hand-out format.

faq.q: Is the bundle 6 separate images or one sheet?
faq.a: Six separate images by default. We can lay them out on a single sheet at no extra charge if you ask.

faq.q: How fast for a single item?
faq.a: Usually 3 to 5 days. Bundles take 7 to 14 days depending on detail.

name: Battle Map
lede: Encounter maps painted by hand for in-person or virtual tabletop play. Gridded or ungridded, color or black & white, sized to your needs.

included.name: Hand-drawn aesthetic
included.body: Old cartography feel, hand-lettered labels available, paper-texture overlays.

included.name: VTT-ready exports
included.body: Roll20 and Foundry-compatible PNG at the right pixel-per-square count.

included.name: Color or B&W
included.body: We do both. B&W reads cleaner at small print sizes, color reads better on screen.

faq.q: Why is this quote-only?
faq.a: Maps vary enormously in scope. A small ambush map is different from a 60×80 city-block fight. We quote per brief.

faq.q: Do you do digital labels or hand-lettered?
faq.a: Both. Hand-lettered for the medieval feel, digital for legibility at small sizes.

name: World / Region Map
lede: Region or full-world map for homebrew campaigns and modules. Stylized, decorative, the kind that gets pinned to the wall behind the GM screen.

included.name: Stylized cartography
included.body: Painted, not procedural. Decorative compass roses, sea monsters in the corners, gilded borders if you want them.

included.name: Labels and place names
included.body: Hand-lettered or typeset, your call. Up to 30 named places at the floor of the price range.

included.name: Print-ready master
included.body: Sized for canvas or paper print as well as digital.

faq.q: How many places can I name on a $300 map?
faq.a: Up to 30 named places at the floor. More places, more rivers, more icons all add cost.

faq.q: Can I commission a region map first and a world map later?
faq.a: Yes. We hold the style notes so the world map will match if you scale up.

name: Single Custom Token
lede: A single character token painted from scratch for the virtual tabletop. Built for the circular frame, not cropped from a square portrait.

included.name: Designed for the circle
included.body: Head and shoulders sized to fill the round frame. No clipped corners.

included.name: Two export sizes
included.body: 512px for the table, 1024px for hover and inspect.

included.name: Decorative border
included.body: Painted frame: ornate, simple, or themed to fit the character.

included.name: Transparent PNG
included.body: Drop into Roll20, Foundry, Owlbear Rodeo, anywhere a round PNG belongs.

faq.q: Why the price range?
faq.a: $40 is a clean token with a simple border. $60 adds glow effects, more elaborate frames, or animated-feeling design.

faq.q: Can you match an existing portrait of mine?
faq.a: Yes. Send the portrait and we will build a matching token. Mention "matching portrait" in your brief.

faq.q: Do you do animated tokens?
faq.a: Not yet. Static PNG only. Animation is on the roadmap.

name: Token Pack (5 originals)
lede: Five custom tokens painted in matching style. The cheapest way to get the whole party on the screen at once.

included.name: Matching border style
included.body: All five tokens share a frame design, so the party reads as one set.

included.name: Bulk discount baked in
included.body: Per-token is $36 in a 5-pack vs $40 to $60 individually.

included.name: Mixed PCs and NPCs fine
included.body: Use the five slots however you want.

faq.q: Can I order 4 tokens instead of 5?
faq.a: Order four individual tokens. The 5-pack is a discount that activates at 5 tokens.

faq.q: Can I get more than 5 in a pack?
faq.a: We quote 8+ token sets individually since the per-token rate keeps dropping. Reach out.

name: Convert Client Art to Token
lede: You have a portrait already. We turn it into a clean, circular VTT-ready token with a decorative border. No repainting, just expert cropping and token design.

included.name: Smart crop
included.body: We crop and reframe so the head fills the circle properly, not a clipped square.

included.name: Decorative border
included.body: Painted frame that suits the character. Choose simple, ornate, or themed.

included.name: Transparent PNG
included.body: Drop-in ready for Roll20, Foundry, anywhere round PNGs go.

faq.q: What art can I send?
faq.a: Anything you have the right to use. A portrait from us, from another artist (with their OK), or from yourself. We don't convert AI-generated art.

faq.q: What if the original art doesn't crop well?
faq.a: We will flag it before charging you. Some pieces need a partial repaint, which we would quote at single-token rates instead.

name: Campaign Companion
lede: Ten tokens plus two NPCs every month, painted to a campaign style guide we set up once. For GMs whose tables eat through references between sessions.

monthly.cadence: Ships on the 15th of each month

included.name: 10 tokens + 2 NPCs / month
included.body: Mix of player tokens, NPC tokens, and supporting character portraits.

included.name: Locked style guide
included.body: We set palette, era, and lighting in your first month and hold the line on every later piece.

included.name: Pause anytime
included.body: Pause for a month if your campaign is on break. Cancel before the next cycle.

included.name: First-month payment upfront
included.body: No deposit model. You pay the month, you get the month's drop.

faq.q: What if I don't use my monthly allotment?
faq.a: Unused slots don't roll over. Use them or lose them. Most subscribers use 80% or more each month.

faq.q: Can I swap a token for an NPC?
faq.a: Yes. One NPC counts as roughly 3 tokens of slot. We work it out at your monthly check-in.

faq.q: How do I cancel?
faq.a: Email us before the 10th of the month and your next cycle will not bill.

name: Campaign Companion · GM Tier
lede: Tokens, NPCs, and one battle map every month. Built for long-form campaigns that need a steady drip of art without thinking about it.

monthly.cadence: Ships on the 15th of each month

resolution: 512 + 1024 px tokens · 4K NPCs · standard battle map

included.name: Everything in Companion plus more
included.body: Bigger token and NPC allotment, plus a standard battle map every month.

included.name: Map size baseline
included.body: 30×40 or smaller fits the included scope. Larger maps quoted separately at retainer-friendly rates.

included.name: Same style guide model
included.body: Set up once. Every piece stays in style for the duration of your campaign.

included.name: Pause or cancel anytime
included.body: Same flexibility as the Companion tier.

faq.q: What counts as a 'battle map'?
faq.a: Standard battle map up to 30×40 squares. Larger maps come out of separate retainer-friendly quotes.

faq.q: Can the GM tier replace a custom NPC pack?
faq.a: Often, yes. Three NPCs per month is close to a 6-month custom NPC pack at a fraction of the upfront cost.

faq.q: Can I pause without losing my style guide?
faq.a: Yes. We hold style guides for 12 months after the last paid cycle.
